FACT-2.gloss: Meredith spends an average of 4 hours researching and writing each article

RULE-1.gloss: If x wrote m articles on Monday, and 2/5 of m is f, and m plus f is t, then x wrote t articles on Tuesday
RULE-1.formula: ∀x∀m∀f∀t (Wrote(x, monday, m) ∧ Product(0.4, m, f) ∧ Sum(m, f, t) → Wrote(x, tuesday, t))

RULE-2.gloss: If x wrote t articles on Tuesday, and twice t is w, then x wrote w articles on Wednesday
RULE-2.formula: ∀x∀t∀w (Wrote(x, tuesday, t) ∧ Product(2, t, w) → Wrote(x, wednesday, w))

RULE-3.gloss: If x wrote m articles on Monday, t articles on Tuesday, w articles on Wednesday, and m plus t plus w is s, then x wrote a total of s articles
RULE-3.formula: ∀x∀m∀t∀w∀s (Wrote(x, monday, m) ∧ Wrote(x, tuesday, t) ∧ Wrote(x, wednesday, w) ∧ Sum(m, t, w, s) → TotalArticles(x, s))

RULE-4.gloss: If x wrote a total of s articles, spends p hours per article, and s times p is h, then x spent a total of h hours writing
RULE-4.formula: ∀x∀s∀p∀h (TotalArticles(x, s) ∧ TimePerArticle(x, p) ∧ Product(s, p, h) → TotalTime(x, h))
